title: chore(progress): close report_polish (feature 8 done, report published)

req_statements.R1: WHEN the pool holds both live and retired rows, the report SHALL render a tab bar with two panes — Board (live rows only) and Retired (retired rows only) — both present in the single document, one visible at a time.
req_statements.R2: WHEN the report is opened, the Board pane SHALL be the visible one by default (no storage, no JavaScript needed to reach it).
req_statements.R3: WHILE the pool holds no retired rows, the report SHALL render the board content without a tab bar and without the retired pane.
req_statements.R4: The Retired pane SHALL NOT contain the Recommendations section nor the KPI strip: it is a record, and a retired model can neither be recommended nor win a live headline.
req_statements.R5: The KPI strip (Best overall, Fastest (gen), Lowest latency, Newest model) SHALL be computed from the live rows only — no headline figure may come from a model that was deleted.
req_statements.R6: The Recommendations section SHALL appear after the KPI strip and before the "Weighted global" section.
req_statements.R7: Within every per-dimension list of the report (code, agent, tools, speed in ms, gen t/s, prompt t/s) the rows SHALL run from best performer to worst — descending for the higher-is-better scores and throughputs, ascending for latency — including the lists of the Retired pane.
req_statements.R8: The Board pane SHALL NOT render any retired row (the gray styling and the "retired" badge stay, inside the Retired pane).
req_statements.R9: The Retired pane SHALL state that these models are a record only — retired from the bench, unable to run again.
req_statements.R10: WHILE the pool holds retired rows, the header "models" chip SHALL state the two counts separately (e.g. `18 models (+16 retired)`); without retired rows it SHALL keep the single total.
req_statements.R11: The "task sets" chip SHALL link only to set blocks rendered in the Board pane; a signature that exists only among retired rows SHALL be named as text, never as a link to a block that cannot be seen.
req_statements.R12: The report SHALL remain self-contained — no external resource, at most the existing single inline script — and the two panes SHALL stay switchable with JavaScript disabled (pure CSS).
